title: LOADBEARER / BOOK SUPPORT
core_formula: simple physics -> structural trick -> visual narrative -> collectible design
summary: A heavy base, angled support and reclaimed wood carry the real load while a silhouette makes it look as if a figure is holding the books.
learn: Turn real forces into visible narrative.
FUNCTION CAN BECOME THE VISUAL JOKE.
Let one expressive element create identity while the rest remains structurally calm.
EVERY MATERIAL SHOULD EARN ITS PLACE.
